title.zh: QA 最小复核：S-2 签名留证卡（`2f361d91`）——签名块字段/范围/does_not_open_window 齐全、S-1/S-2 两处 signature_status 一致、S-1 仅签名两行改动、spec 字节三处逐位相同、两 manifest 12/12+3/3、边界 10 文件 → 可发 G-L1 token

intent.zh: 对 S-2 签名留证卡（提交 **`2f361d91`**，parent `beeca456`）做最小记录核对：① S-2 receipt 签名块（status=`signed_pending_window`、`signed_object=true`、signer/signed_at/method/scope、material_sha256=c8bb71ef…/18,299 B、`does_not_open_window` 五项条件、note 对 README sha 变化的说明）；② S-1 与 S-2 两处 `signature_status` 一致（S-1 signed / S-2 signed 2026-11-08 / S-3 not signed），S-1 `signatures_required` 的 S-2 行 = SIGNED，且 S-1 判据/事实未被顺手改动（diff 逐行）；③ spec.md 工作树/HEAD blob/父提交 blob 三处 sha `bb064fe0…`/39,379 B/344 行且本提交不含 spec.md；④ S-2 README 状态行/§5/§7/§8 签名记录与 sha 对应；两 manifest 独立重算 12/12 与 3/3、编码卫生；`2f361d91` 只含 10 文件、`src/tests/fixtures/scripts` 零 diff；四门禁 unit 1387/0/402。**只读 + 只写本卡证据；零 GPU。**
intent.en: Minimal record check of the S-2 signature evidence card: S-2 receipt signature block, cross-document signature_status consistency, S-1 diff limited to signature lines, spec byte invariance, README signature record, manifests, boundaries and gates.

acceptance: **S-2 receipt 签名块齐全**：`status=signed_pending_window`、`signed_object=true`（顶层与 boundary 两处）；`signature` = signer=user / signed_at=2026-11-08 / timezone Asia/Shanghai / method=聊天卡双签 / scope=S-2a 计划 + S-2b（`baseline_free 13,302`、signed floor `10,230`、`floor_effective=max(signed,现场)`）+ authoring 例外（2026-11-08 预批、仅本采集窗）+ 失败条款；`material_sha256=c8bb71ef…`/18,299 B（= `beeca456` 的 README，即我 r2 复核过的版本）；`does_not_open_window` 含 QA PASS + Chief token + 现场 floor 取更高 + monitor 60/60 util<40 + 零编译；note 明确「签名绑旧 sha、manifest 记当前 sha」✅。

**旧措辞已改且不矛盾**：`material_fixed_r2_pending_qa_recheck_and_user_dual_sign` → `signed_pending_window`；`signed_object false → true`（两处）；`awaiting.user_s2_dual_sign` → SIGNED；`non_claim[0]` 与 README §7 改为「已签但仍不构成开窗、仍需 QA PASS + Chief token + 现场条件」；`awaiting.chief_g_l1_token` 仍 pending —— 全文一致、无自相矛盾 ✅。

**`signature_status` 一致**：S-2 receipt 与 S-1 receipt 均为 S-1 signed 2026-11-08 / **S-2 signed 2026-11-08** / S-3 not yet signed；S-1 `signatures_required` 的 S-2 行 = SIGNED 且带 anchor 与「不构成开窗」；S-1 receipt diff **仅 2 行**（`signature_status.S-2` 与 `signatures_required` S-2 行），判据/事实/other 块零改动；S-1 manifest 仅 receipt sha 更新、spec.md 行 sha 不变 ✅。
**spec 字节未动**：工作树、`HEAD` blob、`HEAD^` blob 三处 spec.md sha 均 `bb064fe0a85ab38abba8043768666a0d9f73fc53d9f2f3dd72eace060c8a924d` / 39,379 B / 344 行；`2f361d91` 提交不含 `spec.md` ✅。

**README/manifest/门禁/边界**：S-2 README 状态行改为「已双签、待 token/现场条件（签名不构成开窗）」，§5 标题标已签，§8 新增签名条目（签名对象 README `c8bb71ef…`/18,299 B、留证卡锚点、sha 变化属预期、签名不构成开窗）；S-2 manifest **12/12**、S-1 manifest **3/3** 独立重算；两目录编码卫生；`2f361d91` 恰 10 文件（S-2 三件 + S-1 receipt/manifest + 卡 + 4 runs）；`src/`/`tests/`/`fixtures/`/`scripts/` 零 diff；四门禁 fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda exit 0、unit **1387/0/402** ✅。
note: Chief 2026-11-08 派工：S-2 签名留证卡最小复核（G-L1 开窗前最后一道记录核对，快出；零 GPU）。复核目标 2f361d91。结论：PASS → 可发 G-L1 token。
